entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Hats and other headgear, plaited or made by assembling strips of any material, whether or not lined or trimmed
entries.comment: This reduced rate applies only to pressure clothing for the treatment of lymphodema and pressure clothing, head covering masks and face covering masks for the patient with burns.
